pages.supportfund.title: Support ROUT
pages.supportfund.lead: ROUT runs without ads or trackers. Contributions pay for the servers. Every contribution lands in a public, signed ledger anyone can check.
pages.supportfund.coverage.title: Server costs this month
pages.supportfund.coverage.unknown: Monthly server costs have not been filled in yet, so no coverage is shown. Received this month: {{amount}}.
pages.supportfund.form.title: Make a contribution
pages.supportfund.form.level: How visible do you want to be?
pages.supportfund.level.1.title: Public
pages.supportfund.level.1.desc: Your @handle appears in the ledger and you get the supporter crown on your profile.
pages.supportfund.level.2.title: Pseudonymous
pages.supportfund.level.2.desc: No name. You appear as Supporter #number and get a proof you can share.
pages.supportfund.level.3.title: Anonymous
pages.supportfund.level.3.desc: Only the amount counts. No number, no name, no named proof.
pages.supportfund.rail.sepa.title: Bank transfer
pages.supportfund.rail.sepa.desc: 0% fees. Scan the QR code in your banking app.
pages.supportfund.rail.stripe.title: Card, iDEAL, Bancontact, Apple Pay, Google Pay
pages.supportfund.rail.stripe.desc: Through Stripe. No trackers are added to this page.
pages.supportfund.form.notReady: Donations are not open yet. Check back soon.
pages.supportfund.error.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
pages.supportfund.error.rate: Too many attempts. Try again later.
pages.supportfund.sepa.title: Make the transfer
pages.supportfund.sepa.intro: Use exactly this structured communication. It lets us recognise your payment without keeping your name or account number.
pages.supportfund.sepa.name: Beneficiary
pages.supportfund.sepa.keepHint: Use this link to follow your contribution and get your receipt. Anyone with the link can see it; do not share it.
pages.supportfund.status.title: Your contribution
pages.supportfund.status.pending: Waiting for your payment. A bank transfer can take up to one business day.
pages.supportfund.status.failed: The payment did not go through.
pages.supportfund.status.missing: This link is incomplete. Open the link you got when donating.
pages.supportfund.status.cancel: You cancelled the payment. Nothing was charged.
pages.supportfund.receipt.title: Contribution receipt
pages.supportfund.receipt.notTax: This is not a tax certificate: gifts to ROUT are not tax deductible.
pages.supportfund.receipt.verify: Check the signature with the public key at rout.be/support/donations.
pages.supportfund.cred.title: Supporter credential
pages.supportfund.cred.desc: An SD-JWT credential (EdDSA) for your digital wallet. You choose which details to show.
pages.supportfund.proof.title: Inclusion proof
pages.supportfund.proof.desc: Shows your contribution is in the signed ledger tree. It contains your number and amount, but no name.
pages.supportfund.verify.title: Check a proof
pages.supportfund.verify.desc: Paste an inclusion proof. The check runs in an isolated part of your browser.
pages.supportfund.verify.ok: Valid: this contribution is in the signed ledger.
pages.supportfund.verify.noKey: The ledger key is not available.
pages.supportfund.ledger.title: Public ledger
pages.supportfund.partners.title: Partners and infrastructure
pages.supportfund.partners.lead: Who supports ROUT and which services we use. Suppliers are not partners: we simply pay them.
pages.supportfund.partners.fundsEmpty: No grants yet. Once one is awarded, it will appear here with proof.
